# SPONSIFY

> SPONSIFY is a digital marketing agency based in Qatar. It designs websites, manages social media, runs paid ads on Meta, Google and TikTok, builds marketing automation and lead generation systems, and develops mobile and web apps. It works in Arabic and English.

## Services
- Website design: fast, mobile-first websites in Arabic and English.
- Social media management: content, reels and community management.
- Paid ads: Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns measured by cost per customer.
- Marketing automation and lead generation: Google Maps lead research, email outreach and automatic follow-ups.
- App development: custom mobile and web apps.
- Creative production: graphic design, motion graphics and AI video.

## Clients and work
- Kaza Store: Charcoal e-commerce store.
- Sharmax Motors Qatar: Motorcycles, ATVs and golf carts.
- PerfUp Qatar: Health, massage and physiotherapy.
- Eat & Lose: Healthy food restaurant.
- UniHealth: Supplements and sports nutrition.
- Greece Residency Capital: Greece residency by investment.
- Wady: B2B platform linking restaurants and distributors.
- DARS: Education platform.
- Rowwad: Advisory and business solutions.
- Masar: School transport app.
- Work for DARS: ad creatives, social posts, motion graphics and AI video. Rowwad: ad creatives and website concepts. Masar: app demo videos.

## How SPONSIFY works
1. Audit: a free 15-minute review of the business's online presence.
2. Strategy: goals, channels and budget.
3. Launch: build, publish and run, with client approval on key steps.
4. Grow: monthly reports and optimization.
